evidence.excerpt: Sabo provided a six-month consulting engagement to a domestic manufacturer of outdoor metering cabinets, advising on gasket material selection and anti-condensation heater sizing. She has also contributed expert opinion in two product certification disputes concerning moisture ingress in sealed outdoor housings.
